source_note: Elmina Valley Central Park pilot. Geometry: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), retrieved 15 Oct 2026. Google imagery is background only. Existing tree/seat inventory is unavailable; proposed trees and dimensions are hypothetical.
method_note: Added-tree-only experiment: existing shade is not surveyed. Shown shade is from the proposed canopies only; it is not total site shade or a measured improvement. Planting zones are provisional GIS masks, not approved locations.

provenance.route_processing: Longest dry segment of selected OSM footway within the OSM park polygon.
provenance.planting_processing: Park inset 2m, water buffer 3m, mapped walkways/buildings/playground/pitches excluded with 2m buffers. Demonstration-only mask; unrecorded constraints are unknown.
provenance.scope_note: A selected mapped park/footway within City of Elmina, not the complete 300-acre Central Park masterplan.
provenance.tree_source: Hypothetical proposals, radius5m and modelheight7m; no existing-tree inventory.
